theme_strategy: Apple-Minimalist with Saffron Accents (Light-mode prioritized, high-contrast)

typography.numbers: Tabular lining enabled (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for stable clock and calendar displays
typography.forbidden: Inter for headings, generic sans for brand moments, Roboto

layouts_and_grids.modal_container: Fixed bottom for mobile (Action Sheet style), rounded-t-3xl. Width w-full max-w-md mx-auto. For screens > 430px, center as standard modal.
layouts_and_grids.calendar_grid: 7-column grid (grid-cols-7) with tight gaps (gap-1 or gap-2). Center-aligned content.
layouts_and_grids.time_picker_grid: 3-column grid for Hour | Minute | AM/PM. CSS scroll-snap layout.

components.name: CrossPlatformDateTimePickerModal
components.instructions: Replace native <input type='date' /> and <input type='time' /> entirely. Create a custom React portal/modal. The modal background MUST be bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md (No pure transparency). Must support internal state for selection that only commits to parent state when 'Done' is tapped. If 'Cancel' is tapped, discard internal changes.

components.name: CalendarMonthView
components.instructions: True calendar UI. Header: Month/Year with Prev/Next chevrons. Days: 44x44px minimum touch targets. Active day gets bg-[#FF9933] text-white rounded-full shadow-md. Today's date (if unselected) gets text-[#FF9933]. Tamil/English localized headers must be supported via props.

components.name: ScrollSnapTimePicker
components.instructions: Apple-style vertical dials for time selection. Create 3 columns (Hour, Min, AM/PM). Use CSS 'overflow-y-scroll snap-y snap-mandatory' and hide scrollbars. Each tick must be snap-align-center. Apply a fade mask (mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, black 40%, black 60%, transparent)) to the container. Selected item in the center gets high contrast text-primary, unselected gets text-secondary.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft diffuse shadows for modal: shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]
visual_enhancers.radius: Modal: rounded-t-[32px] (mobile) or rounded-3xl (desktop), Highlighted Days: rounded-full
visual_enhancers.motion: Slide up animation: translate-y-full to translate-y-0 with duration-300 ease-out. Overlay fade in.

accessibility.touch_targets: Strict minimum 44x44px minimum touch targets on ALL interactive elements (days, chevrons, done/cancel buttons).
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY on all elements. Example: data-testid='custom-datepicker-trigger', data-testid='calendar-day-15', data-testid='time-picker-hour-wheel', data-testid='picker-done-btn', data-testid='picker-cancel-btn'.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER use native <input type='date'>, <input type='time'>, or <input type='datetime-local'> to guarantee identical cross-platform (iOS/Android) rendering.
Do not mutate actual parent form state until 'Done' is pressed. Implement local state within the picker component.
Ensure responsive layout scales correctly between 320px and 430px (iPhone SE to Pro Max).
Tamil/English language support: Title and action labels ('Done', 'Cancel') must accept localized string props.
Do not center-align the main app layout wrapper. Align text predictably.
No AI emojis in UI components.
Ensure the modal overlay background is explicitly defined (bg-black/50) to prevent transparency overlap issues.
